backupScreen.title: Backup & restore
backupScreen.dataNotice: Your progress (review cards, streak, achievements, settings) lives only in this browser. There is no account and no cloud. Download a backup file to keep it safe, or import one to move your progress to another browser or restore it.

export.title: Download a backup
export.error: Could not build the backup file.

import.title: Restore from a file
import.hint: Pick a chino-app backup file (.json). You will see what it holds before anything changes.

confirm.title: Confirm import
confirm.replace: Replace: your current data is deleted and replaced by the file. This cannot be undone.
confirm.merge: Merge: keeps the newest entry per card; nothing local is deleted.

error.corrupt: That file is not valid JSON — it is not a backup.
error.invalidType: That file does not look like a backup.
error.wrongApp: That backup belongs to a different app.
error.unknownVersion: That backup was made by a newer version of the app.
error.unknownStore: That backup holds data this app does not know.
error.applyFailed: Import failed and your data was left untouched.
